predeclared: 2026-09-20, before any measurement below was run

calibration.quantity: (depth-d alpha-beta value minus static evaluation) / selective.allowance(config)
calibration.rule: each margin default must cover the largest observed swing over the calibration corpus on the supported scale; the adopted-scale requirement is reported separately and is not silently folded into the default

corpus.note: disjoint seed from the calibration corpus

fixed_depth.rule: a technique that never fires on this corpus is not accepted

sensitivity.rule: report firing rate, node ratio and action changes against the mode's reference; a setting below the calibrated margin is recorded as measured-unsafe, not adopted

mate_oracle.rule: mate-distance pruning must reproduce the action, score and bounded-proof verdict of the same search with it disabled, on every case

paired.colours: both, paired on the same start
paired.termination: official wins only; a capped game is unfinished, never a draw
paired.note: 15 held-out positions, both colours, five candidate modes: 150 games

acceptance: defaults stay off unless equal-time paired play is at least non-regressive; node reduction alone is not acceptance
